findings.requirement: Record mode, principal, roots, exclusions and no credential read.
findings.remediation: Added DISCOVERY_AUTHORIZATION block: LOCAL_DISCOVERY_ENUMERATION, OS principal, per-root totals, skipped reasons, credential-store exclusion, and content-read policy.

findings.title: 13 SOURCE_READ entries lacked ACL/principal
findings.requirement: Add acl_ref/principal/mode or downgrade read class and hold.
findings.remediation: Captured live icacls for all 13 sources at BUILD_STAGING, DEPLOYED and ORIGINAL; deployed/original refs and hashes added to the source ledger.
findings.remaining: Original domain action only: Original Source Owner ACL acknowledgement remains UNBOUND.

findings.title: Author guard red lights lacked characterisation; selection first_fail empty
findings.requirement: Add typed interpretation; make selection_guard first_fail non-empty.
findings.remediation: GUARD_RESULTS now carries interpretation for pack/m22/selection guards; selection_guard v2 emits explicit first_fail and supports digest relocation.

findings.title: 2/13 original_path stale (missing OLD\)
findings.requirement: Correct locators or add candidates; keep bytes stable.
findings.remediation: Added SOURCE_LOCATOR_CORRECTION overlay; corrected CTRLW0/STARTW0 locators match the copies; canonical pack bytes unchanged.

findings.title: Selection receipt embeds author absolute path
findings.requirement: Use digest/identity validation or a relocated receipt.
findings.remediation: selection_guard v2 default mode validates digests and returns RELOCATED_SELECTION_VALID_BY_DIGEST; strict path mode still fails closed.
findings.remaining: Original domain action only: None; path is provenance only.

findings.title: CSV UTF-8 BOM
findings.requirement: Write UTF-8 without BOM or declare utf-8-sig.
findings.remediation: Rewrote CSV without BOM; first header is `set`; 485 rows.

findings.title: Deployment not atomic and no before-SHA
findings.requirement: Stage tmp + rename; record target before/after SHA.
findings.remediation: Deployment step uses per-file tmp+os.replace and records before_tree_sha256 / after_tree_sha256 in DEPLOYMENT_RECEIPT.
findings.remaining: Original domain action only: Final before/after SHAs are generated at deployment.

findings.title: 15-file identity wording

findings.remediation: Updated identity check output, precheck, summary and compliance wording.

findings.title: FirstFail token drift

findings.remediation: Added TOKEN_MAP and package_first_fail to all 7 NT records.
